lines.trans: The flyer says if several households team up for a group buy, they discount the move-in cleaning—would you like to join?
He rounded up ten neighborhood moms! Because of that, my move-in cleaning is free—oxygen sanitization included!
Since my mother always heads savings clubs and the women's association, I have zero shyness around neighborhood moms.
Now all I have left to sort out is moving my boxes! Should I hire full-service movers?
Of course hire full-pack movers—that is by far the easiest.
You do not actually have that much luggage here, Senior—how about moving these items over little by little starting today?
Yes, totally—that will come out way cheaper! Joon-mo, will you lend me a hand?
Count me out—the two of you knock yourselves out! How much could you possibly save going to all that trouble?
I will help you pack up your boxes, Senior!
